mentions.name: taro.codes
mentions.description: This personal website adds a lightweight custom client-side rendering built on the Navigation API and Shadow DOM, along with refactors such as migrating from Sass to native CSS and improving encapsulation with Shadow roots.
mentions.source_excerpt: Also used the new Navigation API (and some Shadow DOM) to build a cheap, custom client-side rendering (sort of) into my site (https://taro.codes), and some other minor refactors and cleanup (finally migrated away from Sass to just native CSS, improved encapsulation of some things with Shadow roots, etc).
